summary_en: Fukuvi Chemical Industry increased its interim dividend to 16.50 yen per share from 15.50 yen, effective December 10, 2026. The full-year dividend forecast was also raised to 33.00 yen per share (16.50 yen interim plus 16.50 yen year-end), representing a 2-yen increase from prior guidance and 4 yen from the previous fiscal year.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend of Surplus (Interim Dividend Increase) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
Fukuvi Chemical Industry announced on November 13, 2026, that it has resolved to increase its interim dividend to 16.50 yen per share for the period ending September 30, 2026, up from the previously forecast 15.50 yen per share. The interim dividend will be effective on December 10, 2026, and the total amount distributed will be 317 million yen.

Simultaneously, the company revised its full-year dividend forecast upward. The year-end dividend is now expected to be 16.50 yen per share, bringing the total annual dividend to 33.00 yen per share. This represents a 2-yen increase from the May 14, 2026 guidance (which had projected 31.00 yen annually) and a 4-yen increase compared to the previous fiscal year ended March 31, 2025 (which paid 29.00 yen annually).

The company stated that while second quarter results were somewhat weaker than plan in certain areas, full-year earnings guidance remains unchanged. Taking into account the progress of earnings, financial position, capital requirements for future growth investments, and the level of shareholders' equity, the company determined to enhance profit returns to shareholders on a sustainable and continuous basis. The dividend policy continues to incorporate progressive dividend increases as part of the company's commitment to shareholder returns.
